adjudication.rationale: The diff removes all controller-level usage of `group.usernames` for membership sync: `Admin::GroupsController#create` no longer sets `group.usernames` (was `params[:group][:usernames]`), and `update` no longer assigns `payload[:usernames]` (the old `update_put` did). On the client side, `Discourse.Group#asJSON` also drops `usernames`, and the admin controller now calls `group.save()`/`group.create()` instead of `saveWithUsernames`/`createWithUsernames`. Membership is now managed via the new `add_members`/`remove_member` endpoints and corresponding client methods (`addMembers`, `removeMember`). This creates a valid maintainability/architecture concern: any existing server-side `usernames=` full-list sync behavior (previously exercised by create/update) is now effectively orphaned and could silently rot unless removed or clearly deprecated.
